title: AmbiguousAccount
description:
`ambiguous_account`'s detail: two or more accounts hold `connector` connected, and
their identities on it aren't all known and the same, so rlxd won't pick one. The
client asks the user once and pins `account`.

```json
{"connector": "claude.ai Slack",
 "candidates": [{"account": 1, "identity": {"workspace": "Acme"}},
                {"account": 3, "identity": null}]}
```

candidates.description: Every account that holds it connected, by slot.

Candidate.description:
One account `ambiguous_account` lists. `identity` is always there, `null` when
unknown.

identity.description: Who the account is on the connector, or `null` when rlxd hasn't read it.

ConnectorIdentity.description: Who an account is on one connector, as a read call of the connector's own said.

email.description: The address, such as a Gmail account's or a calendar owner's.

user.description: The user there, such as a Slack user's name.

workspace.description: The workspace or organisation, such as a Slack workspace's name.
